t: Using the $(6)Mycelial Network$() (A subspace domain containing a living vegetative mass of fungus called the mycelium) this reactor can detect the other $(6)mycelial generators$() and generate massive amounts of FE. $(br2)For this to happen, once instance of each generator needs to be working at the same time.
利用 $(6)菌丝网络$()（一个包含名为菌丝的活性真菌营养体的亚空间领域），该反应堆可以检测其他 $(6)菌丝发电机$() 并产生海量 FE。$(br2)要实现这一点，每种发电机都必须同时有一台处于工作状态。
Maybe new technologies can be discovered in the future using this network.
未来或许可通过此网络发现全新科技。
